design: Factorial overlap-by-nuisance misspecification stress. Exactly one nuisance model is incorrect in the single-misspecification profiles; hidden confounding is fixed at zero in every cell.
monte_carlo_uncertainty: Bonferroni familywise 95% intervals across eight fixed cells; Student-t intervals for mean bias and exact Clopper-Pearson intervals for replicate-level Wald interval coverage.
interpretation: Exploratory synthetic robustness study only. Wald interval coverage and overlap diagnostics apply to this constructed generator and do not establish real-world identification or proxy approval.
prohibited_changes: Do not vary hidden confounding in this study; it is fixed at zero to isolate positivity and nuisance-model misspecification.
Do not combine this stress study with the earlier confounding-strength sensitivity study.
Do not interpret Monte Carlo coverage as evidence of real-world identification.
